key_highlights: ASX set to slip as Wall Street retreats on inflation fears; Fed chief emphasises inflation fight, pressuring global risk assets
U.S. strikes on Iran and Hormuz Strait tensions spike oil prices, creating headwinds for transport and consumer sectors
Australian interest rate expectations rocket, signalling potential RBA policy tightening amid persistent housing inflation
Housing market deteriorates sharply: home values decline in August, auction sentiment crumbles, raising recession-adjacent concerns
Pilbara iron ore production booms; Gateway Resources discovers 7km gold trend in WA, supporting materials sector
Labor's by-election collapse in WA signals political instability, complicating policy certainty for infrastructure and energy
Virgin Australia shielded from oil shock via fuel hedging; Qantas workforce issues persist
Consumer data shows strong weight-loss drug demand, EV uptake acceleration, but grocery prices remain elevated

sectors.trend: Pilbara iron ore output surges; Gateway Resources (GWP.AX) adds 7km gold trend in WA; Bapcor and Metal Hawk among weekly ASX runners. Commodity strength offsets global risk-off.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX benefit from sustained iron ore volumes. Gold miners (GWP.AX, NGM.AX) gain from safe-haven flows amid Iran tensions. Small-cap miners show relative strength.

sectors.trend: Rate expectations rising sharply; mortgage rates higher week-on-week; housing stress and auction declines threaten NPL trajectories. RBA faces sticky housing inflation.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure from rate volatility but benefit from higher yields. Housing downturn risks credit losses. REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) under pressure from falling values.

sectors.trend: Oil prices jump on U.S.-Iran strikes and Hormuz uncertainty. Oil giant retreats from clean energy commitments. Australia sets 'high bar' for fossil-fuel-powered data centres.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, WLE.AX, SXG.AX benefit from oil spike. QAN.AX and VIR.AX partially hedged. Clean-energy transition slows, pressuring renewable names. LNG exporters (SGS.AX, BHP.AX) stable.

sectors.trend: Grocery prices remain elevated domestically; weight-loss drug demand surges; EV uptake accelerates; 'dupe' brand trend grows. Major fruit grower lays off ~1,000 workers.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WTW.AX face margin pressure from input costs. CSL.AX benefits from pharma/health demand. EV supply chain names gain. Consumer discretionary under pressure.

sectors.trend: AI data centre demand transforms industrials (CAT) into high-multiple plays. SpaceX disruption potential. Australia restricts fossil-fuel data centres. SRL project cost overruns deepen.
sectors.implications: ASX tech remains thin; global AI capex benefits CSPs. Infrastructure (WTC.AX, WES.AX) faces SRL overhang. Data centre policy creates regulatory uncertainty.

sectors.trend: Health insurance rebate cuts anger retirees; weight-loss drug demand surges. Childcare sector in crisis with closures and revenue declines.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX, HIC.AX supported by demand. Private health insurers (HIC.AX, MHC.AX) face policy headwinds from rebate cuts.

key_themes: Geopolitical escalation (U.S.-Iran, Hormuz) driving oil spike and risk-off sentiment
Inflation persistence forcing higher rate expectations globally and domestically
Australian housing market in clear downtrend with deteriorating auction sentiment
Political instability post by-election losses complicating policy direction
Commodity strength (iron ore, gold) providing ASX support amid global weakness
Consumer squeeze: elevated grocery prices, health rebate cuts, childcare crisis
Energy transition stalling as oil majors retreat from clean commitments

risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; maintain gold allocation; monitor WDS.AX, WLE.AX for oil-driven upside while protecting transport/consumer names

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA forced into policy tightening amid housing inflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce REIT and rate-sensitive exposure; favour fixed-income ladders; monitor CBA.AX, NAB.AX credit commentary
Underweight property-linked equities (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, WTC.AX); monitor auction clearance rates and CoreLogic data
Avoid policy-dependent sectors (infrastructure, renewables) until political direction clarifies; favour cash-generative large caps
Favour value/dupe brands, essential staples; reduce discretionary exposure; monitor WES.AX, WTW.AX same-store sales

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold and iron ore miners on safe-haven flows and Pilbara production surge
opportunities.rationale: Iran conflict drives gold demand; Pilbara output boom supports iron ore pricing; GWP.AX discovery adds optionality

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical long on oil & gas majors on Hormuz/Iran supply risk
opportunities.rationale: Oil price spike from geopolitical escalation; WDS.AX and WLE.AX benefit directly; Virgin hedged but Qantas less so

opportunities.recommendation: Selective healthcare exposure on weight-loss drug demand and pharma strength
opportunities.rationale: Surging GLP-1 demand; CSL.AX global franchise insulated from domestic policy noise

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce REIT and property-linked exposure; shift to quality dividend large caps
defensive_moves.rationale: Housing values declining sharply, auction sentiment deteriorating, rate expectations rising — triple headwind for property

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge rate risk via short-duration bonds or T-bills; avoid long-duration credit
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA tightening risk elevated; mortgage rates already rising; housing stress may elevate NPLs

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight consumer discretionary and transport on oil shock and demand softness
defensive_moves.rationale: Grocery prices elevated, childcare crisis, Qantas workforce issues, oil spike hits margins

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to open lower on Wall Street weakness and inflation fears. Geopolitical oil spike supports energy but broad risk-off caps gains. Housing data and rate expectations weigh on financials and REITs. Expect volatility; ^AXJO likely testing support. Materials and gold provide relative strength.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious. Persistent housing inflation constrains RBA easing cycle. Political uncertainty delays infrastructure and energy transition spending. Commodity cycle remains supportive for miners. Consumer squeeze may moderate as 'dupe' brands and EV adoption shift spending. A soft landing is possible but housing correction risk is the dominant downside scenario.

U.S.-Iran conflict escalation or de-escalation; Hormuz Strait status

WA by-election aftermath and federal political direction
Iron ore and LNG pricing into Q4 2026
Q3 corporate earnings season (banks, miners) late September
Australia data centre fossil-fuel policy implementation

CoreLogic home value index (national and Sydney/Melbourne)
